attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `ymdA`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, and the model names it in 99% of genomes at 0.44 bits. The other 79 columns are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 69% of calls.

**The first forks carry the `csg` genes.** Columns 1 to 7, `csgC` to `csgG`, [[curli assembly and transport]], are persistent at 85 to 89%. Then columns 12 and 13 are the most hesitant of the window: `ycdU` at 2.22 bits, named 57%, in a region of plasticity in 65% of calls, and an IS3 family transposase at 1.36 bits, in a region of plasticity in 69%. The model names 86% of calls in the 11 columns most in regions of plasticity, against 93% elsewhere.

**A long fork run follows.** `pgaA` to `pgaD`, [[poly-beta-1,6 N-acetyl-D-glucosamine biosynthesis]], are shell at 48 to 61%, then `phoH`, `efeB`, `efeO` and `efeU` are persistent at 83 to 84%, and the `rut` genes, [[pyrimidine utilization]], run from `rutR` to `rutG` at 79 to 83%. The `tor` genes, [[trimethylamine-N-oxide reduction]], follow at 76 to 78%, and `cspG`, `cspH` and `gfcA` to `gfcE`, [[capsule biosynthesis]], close the middle at 51 to 72%.

**Branches run beside these columns.** A branch of 55 families through columns 1 to 55, from `ymdB` to `ptsG`, is persistent at 10 to 11%; another of 11 families through columns 57 to 67, from `hinT` to `ldtC`, at 10%; one of 4 families through columns 71 to 74, from `lolD` to `cobB`, at 10%; and one of 4 families through columns 76 to 79, from `ompA` to `fabA`, at 21 to 28%.

**The window ends in fork columns.** `appA` to `appC`, [[cytochrome ubiquinol oxidase]], are persistent at 66%, the `hya` genes, [[hydrogenase 1 maturation]], at 64 to 65%, and `yccS` at 45%. Across the window the model names 92% of genes at 0.52 bits; inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.45 against 0.21 bits, and names fewer genes, 75% against 97%.

label: ymdA
facts:
WINDOW: the ymdA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ymdA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,648 to 2,727 from dnaA. Read in 518 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ymdA once); 41,440 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.52 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 30,583 calls, named 99%, 0.18 bits; shell 10,130 calls, named 76%, 1.28 bits; cloud 727 calls, named 27%, 4.16 bits. Outside an RGP 31,042 calls, named 97%, 0.21 bits; inside an RGP 10,398 calls, named 75%, 1.45 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 76 fork, 3 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.45 against 0.21 bits) and names fewer genes (75% against 97%); 10,398 of the 41,440 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 12 (ycdU) 2.22 bits, RGP 65%; column 13 ("IS3 family transposase") 1.36 bits, RGP 69%; column 31 (rutE) 0.77 bits, RGP 23%. The 11 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 86%, 0.80 bits on average; the other 69 columns: named 93%, 0.47 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0.2-69%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: ymdA "protein YmdA". named 99%; 0.44 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0.2-69%. named 57-99.6% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 12, named 57%, 2.22 bits.
